Dear Eliza,

Re: Bedroom window repair – Flat 24, 150 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ3 7ZZ (Ref R/PM047-2)

We asked our contractor, Oscar Turner, to contact you to arrange a visit for the bedroom window, but we have not yet had confirmation of an appointment from him. Could you let us know whether he has been in touch with you or visited? It would also help to know whether the window can still be shut and secured at the moment.

In the meantime, if the window cannot be closed securely, please keep the room's door closed when you are out and let us know straight away if it gets worse or lets in water.

We are following this up with the contractor and will update you by 13 March.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Team
